drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.explainer: Messages you started and haven't sent.
drafts.explainerMore: They're saved to your account, so they're here on every device you read your mail on.
drafts.openRecoverTitle: Open this message — we're not sure it was sent
drafts.heldReopenBlocked: Finish or put aside the message you are writing — opening this held one would replace it.
drafts.reopenBlockedUnsaved: Finish or put aside the message you are writing — its last changes are not saved, and opening another would replace them.
drafts.bodyUnavailable: This draft’s text hasn’t reached this device yet. Try again in a moment.
drafts.heldChecking: We're not sure this was sent. We're checking your Sent folder.
drafts.heldNotInSent: We're not sure this was sent. It isn't in your Sent folder.
drafts.heldInterrupted: We're not sure this was sent — the send was interrupted.
drafts.resolveFailed: That didn't reach the server. The message is still held here.
drafts.resolveStillRunning: This send may still be running. You can answer for it once it has stopped.
drafts.discardWhatWaiting: Its send is waiting to go. This cancels the send and deletes the only copy.
drafts.discardStillSending: Not discarded — this message is still being sent, or its send is still being confirmed. Try again in a few minutes.
drafts.discardCancelUnknown: Not discarded — its send could not be cancelled yet. Try again.
drafts.discardUnknownJar: Not discarded — this browser can't read its own send records, so it can't tell whether this message is still going out. Discard it from a browser that can.
drafts.discardChanged: This draft changed and was kept
drafts.discardUnsupported: This server cannot safely discard this draft yet
drafts.discardRefusedUnnamed: That didn't go through, and the server didn't say why. The draft is still here.
drafts.discardQueued: Not discarded yet — this browser could not reach your account. We will keep trying.
drafts.discardAwaitingOrganizer: Asked for. The install that organizes this mailbox discards it on its next pass.
drafts.emptyHint: Start a message and it's saved here after a moment — on this device and every other one.
drafts.scheduledEditTitle: Open this message to edit it — that cancels the scheduled send
drafts.scheduledCancelTitle: Cancel the scheduled send; the message stays here as a draft
drafts.scheduleFailedNote: This message wasn't sent at its scheduled time: {reason}
drafts.filesNotKeptNote: {count, plural, one {Its file was not kept. Attach it again before you send.} other {Its # files were not kept. Attach them again before you send.}}
drafts.scheduleCancelled: Scheduled send cancelled. The message is in Drafts.
drafts.scheduleCancelTooLate: Too late to cancel — this message is already being sent.
drafts.scheduleCancelQueued: No connection — the cancel hasn't reached the server yet. The message is still scheduled until it does.
